integrity: The claim is a self-contained mathematical derivation with a reproducible checker and self-review; no independent scientific audit or priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires the absence of even simple cycles in the base graph.
Path and odd-cycle prism special cases were already classified in arXiv:2407.05809 and arXiv:2608.30601v2.
No equivariant or even-cycle-containing-base classification is asserted.
Finite checking supplements but does not replace the all-graph proof.
title: Prism perfect-matching complexes over graphs with no even cycles
